get.description:
Retrieves account balances and the state of the balances (locked or
available).

Locked assets are those that are currently in an open order.

**Instruction:** `balanceQuery`

get.description:
Retrieves all open orders. If a symbol is provided, only open orders for
that market will be returned, otherwise all open orders are
returned.

**Instruction:** `orderQueryAll`

get.description:
Retrieves an open order from the order book. This only returns the order
if it is resting on the order book (i.e. has not been completely filled,
expired, or cancelled).

One of `orderId` or `clientId` must be specified; provide only one.
If both are provided, `orderId` takes precedence and signed requests
fail signature verification.

**Instruction:** `orderQuery`

get.description:
Retrieves the order history for the user. This includes orders that have
been filled and are no longer on the book. It may include orders
that are on the book, but the `/orders` endpoint contains more up to
date data.

**Instruction:** `orderHistoryQueryAll`

autoBorrowSettlements.description: If true, then tries to borrow during collateral reconciliation.

autoLend.description: If true, then tries to automatically lend with available balance.

autoRealizePnl.description: Determines if the account should have continuous PnL realization.

autoRepayBorrows.description:
If true, then tries to automatically repay borrows with available
balance.

futuresMakerFee.description: Futures maker fee in basis points. Negative if a rebate exists.

futuresTakerFee.description: Futures taker fee in basis points.

spotMakerFee.description: Spot maker fee in basis points. Negative if a rebate exists.

spotTakerFee.description: Spot taker fee in basis points.

AssetClass.description:
Market asset-class filter. `Stock` matches markets involving a
tokenized-stock asset; `Crypto` matches everything else.

locked.description:
Funds that are locked because they are in an order that has not been
executed.

userId.description: User id of the account the payment is associated with.

subaccountId.description: Id of the subaccount the payment is associated with, if any.

symbol.description: The symbol of the market the payment is associated with.

quantity.description: Quantity of the payment. Positive if received, negative if paid.

intervalEndTimestamp.description: The end of the funding interval for the payment.

fundingRate.description: The funding rate for the payment.

estLiquidationPrice.description: Estimated liquidation price for this position.

imf.description: Initial margin fraction for this position.

markPrice.description: Mark price for this position's market.

mmf.description: Maintenance margin fraction for this position.

netCost.description:
Positive if long. Negative if short.

The net cost to enter into the position,i.e., price*quantity for
all positions adjusting this position.

netQuantity.description: Positive if long. Negative if short.

netExposureQuantity.description: Quantity of this futures position including worst case open positions.

netExposureNotional.description:
Notional value of the futures position including worst case open
positions.

pnlRealized.description: Aggregates the amount of pnl realized on this position since opening.

pnlUnrealized.description: Unrealized profit and loss for this position.

cumulativeFundingPayment.description: Cumulative funding payment for this position.

cumulativeInterest.description: Cumulative interest paid for this position's unrealized pnl.

collateral.description: Collateral held for a given spot asset.

unsettledEquity.description: Unsettled claim on the liquidity fund.

totalQuantity.description: Pre haircut quantity of the asset.

balanceNotional.description:
Balance of spot instrument in USDC.

collateralWeight.description: Collateral weight of spot instrument, applied as a haircut.
